lede.en: PhysiClaw's CoreXY drive runs on two GT2 belts, A and B, set on two stacked planes so they never cross. The two belts must be tensioned equally to keep the motion accurate.
lede.zh: PhysiClaw 的 CoreXY 由 A、B 两条 GT2 同步带驱动，分别位于上下两层平面，互不交叉。两条同步带的张力必须一致，运动才能准确。

h3.zh: 装电机 A 的同步带

body.en: The Motor A belt is a single open length with both ends clamped to the X carriage. It must stay flat in one plane and never twist along the way. The teeth grip the toothed pulleys; the smooth back rides on the smooth idlers.
body.zh: 电机 A 的同步带是一整根开口带，两端夹在 X 滑座上。整条带必须保持在同一平面，全程不能扭转。齿面咬合带齿的同步轮，平背面贴着光面惰轮。

body.en: Feed each belt end into the clamp's bottom slot, loop it around the post, and fold it back against itself so the teeth mesh. That teeth-on-teeth grip holds the belt with no extra fasteners.
body.zh: 把同步带的每一端穿入夹具底部的槽，绕过立柱，再折回压在自身上，使齿与齿咬合。这种咬合即可固定同步带，无需额外紧固件。

body.en: Leave Motor A's two M5 screws loose, clamp both belt ends into the clamp, then slide the motor to pull the belt tight.
body.zh: 电机 A 的两颗 M5 螺栓保持松动，把同步带两端夹入夹具，再滑动电机拉紧同步带。

h3.zh: 先夹好同步带，再装夹具

body.en: Make sure the Motor A belt is seated in the clamp's bottom slot before you fix the clamp to the X carriage.
body.zh: 把夹具固定到 X 滑座前，确认电机 A 的同步带已卡入夹具底部的槽。

h3.en: Match the Motor B belt length
h3.zh: 电机 B 的同步带长度相同

body.en: Before fitting the Motor A belt into its clamp, cut the Motor B belt to match it. Both must be the same length.
body.zh: 把电机 A 的同步带装入夹具前，按同样长度裁好电机 B 的同步带。两条必须等长。

h3.zh: 装电机 B 的同步带

body.en: Route the Motor B belt on the upper idler plane. It must not cross belt A. Clamp both ends to the X carriage, the same way as belt A.
body.zh: 电机 B 的同步带沿上层惰轮平面布置，不能与电机 A 的同步带交叉。两端夹到 X 滑座上，方法与电机 A 的同步带相同。

body.en: With both belts installed, push the carriage by hand through its full travel in every direction. It should move smoothly with the same, even resistance throughout. That resistance is just the motors. Confirm there's no sticking, no interference, no twisted belts, and no odd noises, with the two belts on their separate planes.
body.zh: 两条同步带装好后，用手推动滑座沿各个方向走完整个行程。滑座应全程顺畅、阻力均匀，阻力只来自电机。同时确认没有卡滞、干涉、扭转和异常噪声，两条同步带各在自己的平面上。

body.en: If the pulley set screws have no threadlocker yet, apply it now that the belts run smoothly.
body.zh: 如果同步轮的紧定螺钉还没涂螺纹胶，现在同步带已运行顺畅，可以涂上了。

body.en: Equal tension on both belts is essential for a CoreXY motion system. Even a slight difference between the two will skew the gantry's motion. You can adjust a motor's position to fine-tune the tension of its belt.
body.zh: CoreXY 运动系统要求两条同步带张力一致。略有差别，龙门架的运动就会偏斜。微调某条同步带的张力，调整对应电机的位置即可。

body.en: For a quick check, move the X carriage fully to the motor side and pluck the indicated belts with a finger. The two should feel and sound about the same. Matching pitch means roughly equal tension.
body.zh: 快速检查：把 X 滑座推到电机一侧尽头，用手指拨动图中标出的两条同步带，手感和声音应基本相同。音高一致，说明张力大致相等。

body.en: For a precise check, measure each belt with a tuning app on your phone while the X carriage is parked at the marked position. Pluck the belts and aim for 75 Hz. If both read the same frequency, the tension is correct.
body.zh: 精确检查：把 X 滑座停在标记位置，用手机调音 App 分别测量两条同步带。拨动同步带，把频率调到 75 Hz。两条读数一致，张力即正确。
